description: Fetch the outcome of a call previously started with submitCall. Returns status "running" while the work is still going, "cancelling" while a cancellation request settles, "cancelled" if the job stops due to abort, "completed" with the tool result, or "failed" with the error. A durably retained result is collectable from any service process for 15 minutes after settlement. If its executor disappears after dispatch, failed reports that the outcome is unavailable and work or charging may have happened; never automatically resubmit. "expired" means the result window elapsed; "unknown" does not disclose foreign ids. Free: does not call an AI provider.
name: collectCall
